search.snippet: The mithril javelin is a type of member's only Ranged ammunition used by the light and heavy ballistas. They can be fletched by attaching mithril javelin heads to javelin shafts at level 47 Fletching, granting 120 experience per 15 javelins made. They can also be obtained by buying them from the Ranging Guild, the Void Knight Archery Store or from Oobapohk's Javelin Store after Monkey Madness II. See full list on oldschoolrunescape.fandom.com •Before the release of Monkey Madness II, mithril javelins were equippable in the Weapon slot, providing a Ranged Attack of +17 and a Ranged Strength of +18. •On 31 October 2016, the mithril javelin's Ranged Strength bonus was changed from +100 to +85.
